callees.name: _caller_module
callees.pre_condition: file_path is an absolute path to a file within the analyzed Erlang project tree.
callees.post_condition: Returns a module identifier string derived from the path components relative to the project root.

callees.name: _elp_argv
callees.post_condition: Returns the ELP command-line argument list used for the current invocation.

callees.name: _fingerprint_digest
callees.post_condition: Returns a string that uniquely and stably identifies fingerprint — the same fingerprint tuple always produces the same digest string.
